name: comp-552
title: File Upload Icon Grid
blurb: Grid of file type icons with file names and sizes.
description: Multi-file upload in icon grid layout. Each file shown as icon representation by type with name and size, removable.
use_when: File management dashboards, compact file browsers, visual file collections.
avoid_when: Image-heavy uploads; use image-specific variants instead.
a11y: Icons have implicit labels via associated file names. Grid is keyboard navigable.
